Открытые позиции (их ещё называют открыт: Open positions (also called open interest) are the number of contracts currently held open by market participants in a given instrument. Each open trade is counted once: there is a buyer and a seller, and together they form one position.
Когда участник открывает позицию — объём: When a participant opens a position, open interest rises. When a position is closed, it falls.
Данные по срочному рынку публикует Моско: Derivatives market data is published by the Moscow Exchange. Updated once per trading day.
Обычный график стоимости инструмента по: A regular daily price chart of the instrument. Used to compare price action with changes in open interest.
Объём открытых позиций в контрактах. На: Open positions volume in contracts. The chart offers four lines: total open interest, longs, shorts and net position.
Количество участников торгов с открытыми: The number of market participants with open positions, split into buyers and sellers. Shows how many people or firms hold positions, not how many contracts they hold.
The instrument's price on the derivatives market.
Общий объём открытых позиций — сумма поз: Total open positions volume — long positions plus short positions.
Объём позиций на рост или количество уча: Long positions volume, or the number of participants holding such positions.
Объём позиций на падение или количество: Short positions volume, or the number of participants on the sell side.
Разница между объёмом позиций на покупку: The difference between long and short positions volume.
Выше графика есть переключатель категори: Above the chart there is a category switch: view data for retail investors only, institutions only, or both groups at once.
Биржа считает физиков и юриков отдельно,: The exchange counts retail and institutions separately because their behavior often differs. Compare both groups and see where they diverge.
Фьючерсные контракты имеют срок истечени: Futures contracts expire. When the old contract expires, positions roll over to the next one. These moments are marked on the chart with vertical markers naming the new contract — to tell a rise in open interest from a contract rollover.
Кнопка выбора актива открывает список вс: The asset picker opens a list of all derivatives-market futures: FX, index, commodity and single-stock. The list shows name, ticker and trading volume for sorting. Favorite instruments can be pinned with a star.
Вторая вкладка страницы — <strong>«Скрин: The page's second tab is the Signal screener. It is a feed that scans all futures at once and shows where a notable position move happened over the day. The chart shows one instrument; the screener shows the whole market. Same daily data.
Главная величина скринера — насколько чи: The screener's key value is how far a group's net position is skewed to one side. Full short on the left, full long on the right, even in the middle. In the feed this is shown by a “comet”: its head is where the crowd stands now.
Рядом — насколько дневной сдвиг сильнее: Next to it: how much the daily shift exceeds what is usual for this instrument. This separates rare, large shifts from everyday noise.
Отдельная пометка — когда перекос дошёл: A separate marker appears when the skew reaches a level not seen over the selected period (1, 2, 3, 5 years or all-time). This catches slow positioning drift that “sharp move” misses.
Если по инструменту у группы слишком мал: If a group has too few participants in an instrument, the move is treated as noise (a couple of players is not a “crowd”) and flagged as low liquidity. The threshold differs for retail and institutions: there are structurally fewer institutions in the market than private traders.
Открытые позиции сами по себе не сигнал: Open interest on its own is not a “buy or sell” signal. It is an indicator of the strength of the current move and participant involvement. Read it together with price:
В движение вовлекаются новые покупатели: New buyers are joining the move — positions are being opened, not closed.
Идёт набор коротких позиций — участники: Short positions are being built — participants are adding bets on the decline.
Закрытие коротких позиций или фиксация п: Short covering or profit taking. There is a move, but no fresh commitment from participants.
Закрытие длинных позиций без агрессивных: Longs being closed without aggressive selling. Sometimes this is what a fading sell-off looks like.
Чистая позиция выше нуля и растёт: Net position above zero and rising
Чистая позиция ниже нуля и снижается: Net position below zero and falling
Перевес продавцов нарастает. Если паралл: The sellers' edge is growing. If price is falling at the same time, the move and the skew point the same way.
Когда физлица и юрлица массово стоят в п: When retail and institutions are heavily positioned in opposite directions, this sometimes coincides with a change of direction. It is no guarantee.

Внутри есть поиск по тикеру или названию: Inside there is search by ticker or name and filters by type. Favorites can be pinned with a star so they always sit at the top of the list.
Биржа считает позиции <strong>отдельно</: The exchange counts positions separately for two categories of participants. Their behavior often differs: retail tends to chase reversals on emotion, while institutions (professionals) position strategically.
Полезно сравнивать обе группы. Если они: It pays to compare both groups. When they diverge, the market is split and a trend turn is often near. Historically, institutions are right more often.

<strong>Чистая позиция</strong> — разниц: Net position — longs minus shorts. Above zero = buyers dominate, below = sellers dominate.

Как читать комету позиции: How to read the position comet
Это лента <strong>резких движений открыт: This is a feed of sharp open interest moves — like our Telegram alerts, but on screen. It shows in which futures the crowd (retail or institutions) sharply changed its net position over the day.
Данные дневные (обновляются на следующий: Data is daily (updated the day after trading). It describes a fact, not a price forecast.
Слева — привычный график открытого интер: On the left is the familiar open interest chart, on the right this screener. They switch instantly; the tab is remembered in the page URL.
Лента всегда отсортирована по силе: самы: The feed is always sorted by strength: the sharpest moves on top.
On the right — the date the feed data is for.
Столбец «Позиция» — это ось перекоса: сл: The “Position” column is the skew axis: full short on the left, full long on the right, zero (even) in the middle. The comet shows everything at once:
<strong>Где голова</strong> — где толпа: Head — where the crowd stands now (at the edge = “fully long/short”).
<strong>Хвост</strong> — откуда пришли з: Tail — where it came from over the day (its length = size of the shift).
<strong>Размер головы</strong> — сила дв: Head size — strength of the move relative to the other rows of the day: the strongest is the largest.
Точные числа — <strong>при наведении на: Exact numbers on hover over the comet: today's and yesterday's skew, the daily delta in pp. Skew is the tilt of the position (0 = even, 100% = all one way), not the share of participants.
Если позиция группы дошла до уровня, кот: If a group's position reaches a level not seen over a period (quarter, half-year, 1–5 years or all-time), we show it in orange instead of the regular signal: High over a quarter, Low over 5 years, and the strongest — All-time high / All-time low. A record outranks the daily multiple, so it takes its place.
Это ловит <strong>медленный дрейф</stron: This catches slow drift in positions that “sharp move” misses: a position can creep for weeks and set a record without a single sharp day.
В каждой строке — <strong>Сила</strong>: Each row has Strength and a reading: “Added longs”, “Cut shorts” etc. Strength ×4.3 means the position shifted 4.3 times more over the day than this asset usually moves (14-day average); the brighter the number, the stronger the move against the day's backdrop.
<strong>Клик по строке</strong> открывае: Clicking a row opens this asset's chart with the same settings (same group, daily timeframe, one year of history).
Звёздочка в строке добавляет актив в изб: The star in a row adds the asset to favorites, and this toggle keeps only them in the feed.
При добавлении в избранное предложим <st: When you add a favorite, we offer to set up an alert: then a sharp move reaches you on its own, no manual watching needed.
